name: CombatMeter
description: Real-time party DPS/HPS meter with role colours.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Live party DPS/HPS with role colours.
History — damage timeline with navigator and per-source table.

added: The meter now follows every class you swap to during a fight and scores each one on its own.
Your gear, modules, talents, Ability Score, and stats are now saved for each class you play, so they show up on the logs website.
Everyone in your party is now included in a run's records — even players who didn't deal any damage.
fixed: A quick dungeon clear now correctly shows as a clear instead of "Partial".
Runs you played together with other people now group correctly instead of getting mixed up.
